description: Pagefind-powered site search in a native modal <dialog>: combobox input, listbox of results, live result count

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Reflected state — set by open()/close() methods, not intended as initial markup

attributes.name: data-pagefind-path
attributes.description: Directory that holds pagefind.js, resolved against the document base. Set it for subpath deploys (e.g. /my-site/pagefind/).

attributes.name: data-base-url
attributes.description: Pagefind baseUrl prefixed to result URLs. Default: the directory above data-pagefind-path ("/" for the default path).

attributes.name: data-label-trigger
attributes.description: Accessible name of the generated icon trigger (only when no trigger button is authored)

attributes.name: data-label-dialog
attributes.description: Accessible name of the search dialog

attributes.name: data-label-input
attributes.description: Accessible name of the search input

attributes.name: data-label-results
attributes.description: Accessible name of the results listbox

attributes.name: data-label-searching
attributes.description: Status text while a search runs

attributes.name: data-label-empty
attributes.description: Status text when a query matches nothing

attributes.name: data-label-count
attributes.description: Status text for several results ({count} is replaced)

attributes.name: data-label-count-one
attributes.description: Status text for exactly one result

attributes.name: data-label-unavailable
attributes.description: Status text when the Pagefind index cannot be loaded (the developer hint goes to the console)

attributes.name: data-label-error
attributes.description: Status text when a search throws

attributes.name: data-label-untitled
attributes.description: Title shown for a result without meta.title

attributes.name: data-label-navigate
attributes.description: Footer hint after the arrow keys

structure.description: Button that opens the search dialog (generated with a search icon when absent)

childAttributes.name: data-trigger
childAttributes.description: Marks the button that opens the search dialog. Falls back to first <button> if absent.

events.name: site-search:open
events.description: Fired when the search dialog opens

events.name: site-search:close
events.description: Fired when the search dialog closes (Escape, backdrop click, close(), or choosing a result)

events.name: site-search:change
events.description: Fired when the value property sets a new query

methods.name: open()
methods.description: Open the dialog with showModal() and focus the input

methods.name: close()
methods.description: Close the dialog, clear the query and results, and return focus to the trigger

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only: whether the dialog is open

properties.name: value
properties.description: The current query. Setting it runs the same debounced search as typing and fires site-search:change

properties.name: results
properties.description: Read-only copy of the current Pagefind result records (url, meta, excerpt)

states.name: input-debounce-pending
states.description: A keystroke is waiting out the 150ms debounce before searching
